name: direction
useFor: Wrap an app or a region whose text reads right to left in DirectionProvider with dir="rtl", and set dir="rtl" on the element it wraps too so the page's own layout flips with it.
constraints: Setting the provider without the matching dir attribute
Mirroring icons that do not point
source: Extrapolated from the Hoplite website: a wrapper around Base UI's DirectionProvider with no look of its own
title: Direction
description: Sets the reading direction (ltr or rtl) for every Base UI part inside it, so tabs, menus, sliders and scroll areas flip for right-to-left text. It draws nothing of its own.
